Why go: the Full Moon Party by speedboat from Koh Samui

The Full Moon Party takes place on Haad Rin Sunrise Beach, on the south-east tip of Koh Phangan, once a month around the full moon. It runs from dusk to after sunrise, with several sound systems along the beach and fire shows. Party entry is about 200 THB per person, paid at the gate (we don't sell entry tickets). The hard part from Samui is getting there and back: public ferries stop running in the evening, and a night boat home after the party is the only way back unless you stay on Phangan.

Our shared return speedboat solves that for 1,400 THB per person. A minivan collects you from your hotel about an hour before your boat, the crossing to Haad Rin takes about 30–45 minutes, and you choose an outbound departure between 18:00 and 23:00. On the way home you join the shared return boats from Haad Rin between 01:00 and 06:00 the next morning, and the minivan drops you back at your hotel. The Haad Rin pier fee is included. You don't wait for a fixed group departure at 01:00, and you don't need to arrange a taxi on Phangan.

The shared boat is the value option. If your group is 6 or more, or you want to leave and return at exact times without queues, compare the private Full Moon speedboat, which takes up to 10 guests. For the ticketed jungle festival on other nights, see the Half Moon Festival package.

Who this tour is for

  • Party-goers staying on Koh Samui who want door-to-door transport and a flexible return.
  • Solo travellers and couples who don't need a whole boat.
  • Groups who would rather not book a hotel room on Phangan for one night.

Who should choose another tour

  • Groups of 6–10, celebrations, or anyone who hates queues: the private speedboat.
  • Want a music festival with a smaller crowd: the Half Moon Festival package.
  • Want to stay on Koh Phangan for a few nights: see Koh Samui to Koh Phangan for ferries and the kohphangan.com area guides.
  • Under 18s: the party is an adult event with heavy drinking; it is not suitable for children.

Stay safe on party night

  • Watch your drink being made and never leave it unattended; drink spiking is a known risk at Haad Rin. Buckets are much stronger than they taste.
  • Don't swim after drinking, and never swim at night: there are no lifeguards on duty after dark.
  • Stay with your friends and agree a meeting point and a return time before you go.
  • Stay away from drugs. Thai drug laws are severe and police are present on party nights. Read our drugs and alcohol law guide.
  • Only board our boat or licensed boats, and wear the life jacket provided.
  • Carry a photocopy or phone photo of your passport, not the original.

What to bring

  • Cash for party entry (about 200 THB) and drinks. ATMs at Haad Rin have long queues on party night.
  • Your return ticket. Keep it safe: a lost ticket means no ride.
  • A waterproof phone pouch and a charged phone with our WhatsApp number, +66 63 704 0888.
  • Closed shoes or sturdy sandals: broken glass on the sand is common.
  • A light layer for the boat home.

Good to know

  • Sea and weather: boats run only in safe sea conditions. November to January brings the north-east monsoon and the occasional rough night. If we cancel for weather, you choose a full refund or move to another party.
  • Return window: the shared boats home run from 01:00 to 06:00 the next morning. They are not on-demand: allow time for queues and arrive before the last departure.
  • Booking: online booking for a party night closes at midnight Thai time the night before. On the day itself, message us on WhatsApp and we tell you if seats are left. Book early for 24 November, 24 December and 31 December.
  • Mobility: boarding at night means stepping down from a pier into a moving boat. Tell us about any assistance needs before booking.
  • Photography: keep your phone in a pouch on the crossing; spray reaches every seat.

Pickup and meeting point

Hotel pickup and return drop-off are included from Chaweng, Lamai, Bophut, Maenam, Bang Rak and Bang Po. Remote areas (Nathon, Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao, Thong Krut and similar) cost 400 THB per person return; for other areas, send us your hotel on WhatsApp before booking. The minivan collects you about an hour before your boat: 17:00–17:30 for the 18:00 boat, and so on up to 22:00–22:30 for the 23:00 boat. We confirm your exact pickup window, meeting point and pier on WhatsApp after booking.
